acceptance_criteria: All-success empty chat reads retain the existing valid-empty presentation only after every eligible source completes successfully.
All-failed chat reads render unavailable with retry and never render zero conversations.
A failed line alongside successful peers renders a partial list with exact observed-versus-expected source coverage.
An initial selected-thread message failure renders unavailable with retry, distinct from a successful empty thread.
Retained chats or messages after refetch failure remain visible but are marked stale with bounded last-success age.
Recovery clears unavailable or stale state only after a fresh successful query.
Deep links distinguish an unavailable source, a missing conversation, and valid empty history.
Realtime connection and reconciliation evidence remain separate from chat/message data currentness.
Inbox and Line Detail use the same bounded adapter for initial, partial, stale, empty, and recovered states.
Mutation coverage fails if chat or message query state is reduced to a data-only empty-array fallback.
Replay, no-work, or recovery decisions require complete current observation or an independently authoritative receipt.
Tests and telemetry use reserved synthetic values and expose no identities, payloads, credentials, locations, raw errors, or process details.
blast_radius: Unified Inbox and per-line history inspection across every eligible fleet line; failed or stale reads can otherwise appear to prove that no conversation, unanswered message, replay work, or recovery gap exists.
evidence_summary: Pinned main directly returns raw chat/message query results, while Inbox and Line Detail consume data only and coerce absent results to empty arrays; 6 issue-specific assertions within an 11-of-11 write-free source falsifier observed the claimed projection. All nine cited decisive source and test paths are byte-identical to pinned main. The four cited focused suites passed 182 of 182 tests under the repository-pinned runtime, but none covers initial/refetch chat/message failure or partial-line coverage. Three live identity reads spanning 26 seconds were stable with six current labels; the node, open state, title, URL, update time, and exact body hash remained unchanged while local and SSH remote main stayed at the pin. A 529-issue, 1,984-PR, fully paginated 39-open-PR and 1,333-path-occurrence capture found no owner; three open preservation drafts are collision-only.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding is falsified if the pinned consumers preserve chat/message error, refetch, freshness, retained-data, and source-coverage state and emit valid empty copy only after complete success. The inspected flow does not. The issue's removed audit-only behavior tests could not be recreated because this lane forbids tracked writes, so runtime failure projections remain an explicit implementation-time test obligation; runner-level operating-system transient writes were not syscall-audited.
impact: A transport or partial-source failure is projected as domain truth, allowing operators or downstream reasoning to mistake absent rows for complete current evidence and skip necessary review or replay.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2530 immediately before publication and reject the record if its updated timestamp, title, labels, node ID, URL, or body hash changed.
Reconfirm exact SSH origin, local origin/main, remote main, and the decisive source bytes before ownership or implementation.
Re-scan the fully paginated issue, pull-request, and changed-file estate; PRs #2078, #2500, and #2501 are collision-only drafts, while merged PRs #881 and #2198 are partial history.
Preserve #2444 ingress ownership and #2519 realtime reconciliation ownership while adopting #2447 vocabulary, #2523 presentation rules, and #2527's analogous fail-visible read contract.
Add direct initial-error, refetch-error with retained data, partial multi-line coverage, deep-link, retry, recovery, accessibility, and data-only mutation tests before completion.
Keep automatic replay outside this visibility change and require authoritative source receipts plus separate mutation authority.
